rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for the activity of browsing or using the Internet.

example.english: I enjoy surfing the Internet and reading the news.
example.traditional: 我平時鍾意上網睇新聞。

rows.note: Use this for the sport or pastime of riding waves on a surfboard.

example.english: We went surfing at Big Wave Bay during the summer holidays.
example.traditional: 暑假我哋去大浪灣滑浪。
